bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; increasing the criminal penalty for concealing a dead body; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 609.502, subdivision 1a.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 609.502, subdivision 1a, is amended to read:

Subd. 1a.
Penalty.
A person convicted under subdivision 1, clause (2) or (3), is guilty of a gross misdemeanor. A person convicted under subdivision 1, clause (1), may be sentenced to imprisonment for not more than [-three-][+ 20+] years or to a payment of a fine of not more than [-$5,000-][+ $20,000+] or both.

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective August 1, 2025, and applies to crimes committed on or after that date. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; increasing the criminal penalty for concealing a dead body; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 609.502, subdivision 1a.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 609.502, subdivision 1a, is amended to read:

Subd. 1a.
Penalty.
A person convicted under subdivision 1, clause (2) or (3), is guilty of a gross misdemeanor. A person convicted under subdivision 1, clause (1), may be sentenced to imprisonment for not more than 20 years or to a payment of a fine of not more than $20,000 or both.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective August 1, 2025, and applies to crimes committed on or after that date.
